mapper.select: select count(l.id) as totalLitters, ifnull(sum(l.total_kits), 0) as totalKits, ifnull(sum(l.live_kits), 0) as totalLiveKits, ifnull(sum(l.weaned_count), 0) as totalWeaned from batches b left join litters l on l.house_id = b.house_id and l.batch_id = b.id where b.house_id = #{houseId} and b.id = #{batchId} group by b.id
